title: Certified lower bounds for λ1·Area on cells of pentagon shape space by piecewise-affine transplantation
description:
Computer-assisted proof candidate (for the stated cells), not peer reviewed. This is not a proof of the Pólya–Szegő conjecture for pentagons, nor of any statement about a neighbourhood of the regular pentagon.

A method (PAQC) that certifies F(P) = λ1(P)·|P| > F(regular pentagon) simultaneously for every pentagon P in a six-dimensional box of shape space, using only the first Dirichlet eigenvalues of the 64 corner pentagons and exact matrix inequalities from a piecewise-affine transplantation; six certificates for five boxes, evaluated in ball arithmetic; a partial independent second-party replay; a short paper; and an estimate of the cost of covering a whole region. AI assistance is disclosed in README.md. Licences: text and data CC BY 4.0; code MIT.
